overview_description.description: Imprint is a financial technology company that designs, configures, and operates co-branded financial products such as credit cards, deposit accounts, and installment loan offerings for consumer brands. Its platform enables partner brands to embed tailored payment experiences and rewards into their customer journeys while managing underwriting, rewards, and transaction processing through a proprietary stack. Imprint’s technology supports integration of card products with loyalty systems and analytics to help brands gain insights into customer behavior and engagement. The company also provides modular tools for marketing, risk, and reward customization to align financial products with brand goals.
